title: Pan-Seared Fennel with Caramelized Sweet Caramelsweet
description: A sweet and savory dish featuring pan-seared fennel and caramelized caramelsweet, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Cut the fennel bulbs in half and slice them into 1/2-inch thick wedges.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat. Add the fennel wedges and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until they're tender and caramelized.
While the fennel is cooking, caramelize the caramelsweet in a separate skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently.
Once the fennel is done, transfer it to a baking sheet and top each wedge with a spoonful of the caramelized caramelsweet.
Bake the fennel in the preheated oven for 10-15 minutes, or until it's heated through and the caramelsweet is bubbly.
Serve the pan-seared fennel with caramelized sweet caramelsweet immediately.
